entries.label: Pipette behavior reference
entries.use: Research plus operating manual pp. 22–23 informs the illustrated forward sequence: press first stop in air, immerse, release while immersed, then deliver at first stop, clear at second stop, withdraw while held, and release in air.

entries.label: Eppendorf liquid-handling SOP manual
entries.use: User-supplied reviewed PDF: Eppendorf_Liquid-Handling_SOP_Manual-pipettes-dispensers_Standard-Operating-Procedure (8).pdf, edition ASOP P39 020-16/2025-12, SHA-256 D1407722E4953EB11415D2DC80800467995B75E7CC3D4421D4D81DA6DE6848AB. The URL is Eppendorf's general official manuals portal, not a verified download location for this exact file. Its controlled measuring-condition and mass-volume sections inform the general teaching distinction between accuracy, precision, shared bias, dispersion, and controlled gravimetric checking; it does not supply an in-app procedure.
